description: This source file provides helper functions for manipulating 2D and 3D tables, such as setting linear curves and binning for RPM and other parameters. It includes functions for creating interpolated curves, RPM bin allocations, and table bin adjustments used in engine management system tuning.

methods.name: void setLinearCurve(float array[],int size,float from,float to,float precision)
methods.description: Creates a linear interpolated curve between 'from' and 'to' with specified precision, filling the given array.

methods.name: void setRpmBin(float array[],int size,float idleRpm,float topRpm)
methods.description: Sets RPM bin boundaries within an array based on specified idle and top RPMs.

methods.name: void setTableBin(float array[],int size,float from,float to)
methods.description: Defines a table bin using linear interpolation between 'from' and 'to' with a fixed precision.

methods.name: void setRpmTableBin(float array[],int size)
methods.description: Initializes RPM table bins with default RPM range from 800 to 7000.
